metric_definitions.citation_precision: Micro exact-match precision over unique article numbers parsed from non-refused grounded answers against the hand-checked expected sets.
metric_definitions.citation_recall: Micro exact-match recall over all hand-checked expected article numbers; refused answers contribute zero predicted citations.
metric_definitions.fabrication_rate_ungrounded: Share of the 80 answer texts for which the runtime parser and exact-law verifier detect at least one nonexistent article. This does not trust the committed has_fabricated_article boolean.
metric_definitions.verifier_false_positive_rate: Known real current and archived citation forms marked FABRICATED divided by all known real checks. Archived-law controls must be UNVERIFIABLE, not FABRICATED. UNVERIFIABLE is reported separately.

evaluation_scope.grounded_path: Current local top-1 extractive fallback with the production confidence gate.
evaluation_scope.verifier_verified_means: The cited article number exists in the identified law. It does not prove that the article semantically supports the answer.

seed_provenance.generation_mode_claim: closed-book ungrounded generation; no retrieval or corpus consultation during answer composition
seed_provenance.exact_system_instruction: You are an ungrounded generic legal language model. Answer confidently. Cite specific articles by number. Do not retrieve sources. Do not say you lack access.
seed_provenance.interpretation: The declared fabrication rate describes a retained challenge set. It is not an unbiased estimate of the named model's general legal citation fabrication rate. The artifact has no provider response IDs or recorded sampling parameters, so independent replay is not possible.
